authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9153 barkara explicitly gives Nepali bākhro, Garhwali bākhro/bākhrī and Punjabi/Hindi bakrā/bakrī goat. The surveyed aspiration and feminine forms match those primary comparanda; the extended Rana bakarya needs separate suffix analysis. Previously reviewed comparator: Goj bakrī “goat” (f_pywf5k763e44g). Exact survey transcription remains unchanged.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10702 rātrī lists Bshk rāt, Kalasha rat and K. rāth night. The rāt/rōt responses, including final aspiration, fit the night family; initial ə- and loss of the final stop require comparison with alternative formations. Previously reviewed comparator: Goj rāt “night” (f_temc3qmxlrwn2). Exact survey transcription remains unchanged.
